fusions.name: Swarm Hop
fusions.desc: Casts a strand that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 4 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Stripped Field
fusions.desc: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Chewing Mat
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a mat of gnawing strands for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Leave Nothing
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
